items.text: Athletics trade Josh Donaldson to the Blue Jays for Brett Lawrie, Sean Nolin, Kendall Graveman and Franklin Barreto
Royals trade Vin Mazzaro and Clint Robinson to the Pirates for Luis Rico and Luis Santos
Twins trade Jason Bartlett, Matt Garza and Eddie Morlan to the Devil Rays for Brendan Harris, Delmon Young and Jason Pridie
Red Sox trade Casey Fossum, Brandon Lyon, Jorge de la Rosa and Mike Goss to the Diamondbacks for Curt Schilling
Rickey Henderson signs with the Athletics
Dennis Eckersley signs with the Cubs
Angels trade Andy Messersmith and Ken McMullen to the Dodgers for Frank Robinson, Bill Singer, Mike Strahler, Billy Grabarkewitz and Bobby Valentine
Pirates trade Kiki Cuyler to the Cubs for Sparky Adams and Pete Scott

note: 2026 regular-season games are not in Retrosheet yet, so 2026 here is postseason only, taken from Wikipedia's box scores. Retrosheet adds the full season after it ends.
